enchantments.tooltip: +6 Enhancement Bonus: +6 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Epic Goldcurse: This weapon applies a dangerous, golden curse to enemies struck! They must succeed on a DC25 Fortitude save on each Critical hit or be Paralyzed by solid gold.
Entropic 4: This weapon is intensely powerful, and crackles with destructive, unpredictable magic. It deals an additional 4d6 untyped damage on each hit.
Wounding 2: This weapon saps the health from your enemies, dealing 2 Constitution damage on each hit.

Destruction: On Hit: Your target gains a stack of Armor Destruction. (-1 penalty to Armor Class, -1% of its Fortification. 20 Second Duration. Stacks up to 15 times.) This effect may trigger once every three seconds.
